maddeler.e:
نتلاحم (form VI)
# نَتَلَاحَمُ (natalāḥamu) /na.ta.laː.ħa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَلَاحَمَ (talāḥama)
# نَتَلَاحَمَ (natalāḥama) /na.ta.laː.ħa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَلَاحَمَ (talāḥama)
# نَتَلَاحَمْ (natalāḥam) /na.ta.laː.ħam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَلَاحَمَ (talāḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
